description: This file defines classes and templates for managing Web transfer operations over WebSocket or HTTP, including client and server transfer types, with support for file handling, hashing, and request/response management within the WPEFramework Web namespace.

classes.name: SingleElementFactoryType
classes.description: A template class that manages a single element instance, providing access via the Element() method, with reference counting.

classes.name: ClientTransferType
classes.description: A template class managing client-side web transfer operations, including upload, download, and info collection, with internal state management and request/response handling.

classes.name: ServerTransferType
classes.description: A template class managing server-side web transfer operations, handling incoming requests, file storage, and authorization, supporting file signature validation.

methods.name: StartTransfer
methods.description: Initiates a transfer with a given request.

methods.name: CollectInfo
methods.description: Collects information about a source URL.

methods.name: Upload
methods.description: Uploads a file to a destination URL.

methods.name: Download
methods.description: Downloads a file from a source URL to a local destination.

methods.name: Setup
methods.description: Virtual method to setup remote URL parameters.

methods.name: InfoCollected
methods.description: Virtual callback when info is collected.

methods.name: Transferred
methods.description: Virtual callback when transfer is completed.

methods.name: Authorize
methods.description: Virtual method to authorize a request.

methods.name: LinkBody
methods.description: Handles attaching a body to a request or response.

methods.name: _CalculateHash
methods.description: Calculates hash for a file to include in request or response signature.

methods.name: _ValidateHash
methods.description: Validates the hash signature of a file.
